items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And Clark Terry was on my foursome. And I knew Clark.

ctx.x: Sideman. Well that’s what I probably was all my life. You know, even if I was the leader I was still, when I led the group it was like, you know, if Clark Terry was there, he’d be the leader for that night. Well anyway, what was I saying?
Well I wanted to talk about, you said an interesting thing— © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
